questions.stem: A* uses priority f(n)=g(n)+h(n), where g(n) is accumulated path cost from the start. What does h(n) represent, and what priority results if h(n)=0 for every node, using the same frontier and tie rules?

options.text: h is the complete estimated path cost; setting it to zero makes A* use greedy goal-distance priority.
h measures cost already paid; setting it to zero makes A* use breadth-first depth priority.
h is the next edge’s exact cost; setting it to zero makes A* ignore accumulated cost.
h estimates cost-to-go; setting it to zero makes A* use the UCS cost priority.
